# Home libraries

Local browser distributions, installed from the npm registry with normal TLS verification:

- GSAP 3.14.2 (`gsap/dist/gsap.min.js`), https://gsap.com — Standard License: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/
- Lucide 0.468.0 (`lucide/dist/umd/lucide.min.js`), https://lucide.dev — ISC license.

Keep upstream notices in the distributed files. These local files let the homepage work without a third-party CDN. The periodic-table app's PDF dependencies are separate.
